name: DroneXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Drone and experimental synth, after the Solar 42, built on Neil Baumberger's AmbientModules: a 15-module rack (4 drones, mixer, filter, pads, 2 PapaSrapa, 2 VCOs, LFOs, joystick, sequencer, detector) patched by touch, with 8 macros, an XY pad, a randomizer that never repeats and a brickwall limiter.
